With regards to the fund itself, the Air Services Opportunities Fund is a proposal developed by Edmonton Global and EIA to create a fund of roughly 15, shouldn't say roughly, $15 million to provide support and build back previous share of direct flights into EIA. Edmonton Global member municipalities would share the one-time cost of $15 million based on the allocations that have been developed to fund Edmonton Global. And then third and final level would be the Edmonton Global Audit and Finance Committee itself. From a financial perspective, to be very clear, for the city of Beaumont, again, the total commitment being asked for is $222,500. That amount would be provided to Edmonton Global in three payments. The first one being somewhat around the end of the month, early part of July in the amount of $49,000, I believe, or 44, 45, I believe, sorry.
